sections.title: Sound of o
paragraphs: The letter name is (o) /o/. It makes one main vowel sound, which is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear it in (okos) /ˈokoʃ/, which means smart, clever. This letter makes one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Pull your tongue back and keep it at a mid height. A mid vowel sits between close and open. Open your mouth a little and make your lips into a small circle. Keep your tongue still. Put your hand on your throat to feel the voice shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in all standard positions. You hear it at the start and in the middle of (orvos) /ˈorvoʃ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into a diphthong, which is two vowel sounds that glide together in one syllable. In the English word boat, the lips move and glide at the end. Keep your lips and tongue completely still from start to finish.
